question: In Table 2, which product and strain reached the highest titer, and under what conditions?

trace.query: SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p9.T2' AND row_no>33 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT c1.text AS product, c2.text AS strain, c3.text AS strategy, c4.text AS mode, c5.text AS time_h, c6.text AS titer, c6.id AS titer_cell, c4.id AS mode_cell, c5.id AS time_cell, c2.id AS strain_cell, c1.id AS product_cell FROM cells c6 JOIN cells c1 ON c1.table_id=c6.table_id AND c1.row_no=c6.row_no AND c1.col_no=1 JOIN cells c2 ON c2.table_id=c6.table_id AND c2.row_no=c6.row_no AND c2.col_no=2 JOIN cells c3 ON c3.table_id=c6.table_id AND c3.row_no=c6.row_no AND c3.col_no=3 JOIN cells c4 ON c4.table_id=c6.table_id AND c4.row_no=c6.row_no AND c4.col_no=4 JOIN cells c5 ON c5.table_id=c6.table_id AND c5.row_no=c6.row_no AND c5.col_no=5 WHERE c6.table_id='p9.T2' AND c6.col_no=6 ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(c6.text, ',', '') AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c1.text AS product, c2.text AS strain, c3.text AS strategy, c4.text AS mode, c5.text AS time_h, c6.text AS titer, c6.id AS titer_cell, c4.id AS mode_cell, c5.id AS time_cell, c2.id AS strain_cell, c1.id AS product_cell FROM cells c6 JOIN cells c1 ON c1.table_id=c6.table_id AND c1.row_no=c6.row_no AND c1.col_no=1 JOIN cells c2 ON c2.table_id=c6.table_id AND c2.row_no=c6.row_no AND c2.col_no=2 JOIN cells c3 ON c3.table_id=c6.table_id AND c3.row_no=c6.row_no AND c3.col_no=3 JOIN cells c4 ON c4.table_id=c6.table_id AND c4.row_no=c6.row_no AND c4.col_no=4 JOIN cells c5 ON c5.table_id=c6.table_id AND c5.row_no=c6.row_no AND c5.col_no=5 WHERE c6.table_id='p9.T2' AND c6.col_no=6 AND c6.row_no>3 AND regexp_matches(c6.text,'^[0-9,]+$') ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(c6.text, ',', '') AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 3
